daily.nakshatra: Uttara Ashadha upto 07:06 AM, then Shravana

daily.significance: Parsva Ekadashi — also called Parivartini or Vamana Ekadashi. Vishnu is said to turn onto his other side during his four months of yogic sleep, which is why today closes the second Chaturmasa period. It is one of the more significant Ekadashis of the year. Being Tuesday it also belongs to Hanuman ji, so the fast and the Chalisa sit naturally together today.
whatToDo: Ekadashi vrat if you keep it — Vishnu is the presiding deity
Hanuman Chalisa and Bajrang Baan — Tuesday is his day
Ravi Yoga runs 06:10-07:06 AM; the early window is the cleanest today
Abhijit 11:50 AM-12:39 PM for anything important later in the day
whatToAvoid: Rahu Kaal 03:17 PM to 04:48 PM — start nothing new
Bhadra 08:55 AM to 09:43 PM is long today — hold auspicious beginnings
Rice on Ekadashi, per the usual observance
Curd — last day of the Chaturmasa yogurt prohibition
daily.familyTip: Vishnu turning over in his sleep is a story that lands well with a four-year-old — Vrinda can picture it. It also explains why the grown-ups stop eating certain things today, which makes the fast less arbitrary to her.
